title: OpenExpert configuration
description: Schema for the openexpert.json file consumed by OpenExpert. Environment variables OPENEXPERT_* always take precedence over the file.

modelProvider.description: Which model provider the chat should use.

modelId.description: Identifier of the model as known by the chosen provider.

ollamaBaseUrl.description: Base URL of the Ollama server.

dataDir.description: Directory where the SQLite database and credentials live. `~/` expands to the user's home directory.

googleClientId.description: Google OAuth client ID baked by the distributor (shared client model). End users do not edit this. OpenExpert ships with drive.file scope and a localhost redirect URI.

notionClientId.description: Notion OAuth client ID baked by the distributor (shared public connection). End users do not edit this. The matching client secret lives in secrets.json.

ai.description: Sampling parameters for the chat model.

maxOutputTokens.description: Maximum number of tokens the model may generate per step.

maxSteps.description: Maximum number of tool-calling steps per request.

injectionExtraPatterns.description: Extra regular expressions added to the injection gate.

retentionDays.description: Days to keep chat history before it is pruned.
